dedupe_keys.name: delka silnicnich a zeleznicnich komunikaci lezicich v zaplavovych uzemi

description: Délka silničních a železničních komunikací ležících v záplavových území is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Česká informační agentura životního prostředí. Communications lying in the floodplain are a risk to the connectivity of the transport network and indicate the vulnerability of transport during floods. The indicator indicates the potential flooding of roads according to the GIS analysis for the given n-year of the flood. Coverage: the Czech Republic. The portal shows the English title as "Length of roads and railways lying in flood plains" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Česká informační agentura životního prostředí. Its keywords include záplavové území, cesta dopravní. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/45249130/86b5332110f9bb78088cf35de4f8b453/distribuce/0ae5539496b24f4f8303d9d738c6c752/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
